VBO:0201063.shortDescription: Poogle is a name for a Beagle–Poodle cross.

sources.title: Dog Breed Info — direct Poogle parentage reports
sources.evidence: Fresh primary keeper captions explicitly identify Abigail’s Beagle mother/Standard Poodle father, Valentine’s Beagle mother/Poodle father, Shadow’s Poodle mother/Beagle father and Maggie’s Miniature Poodle father/Beagle mother. Supports broad Poodle pairing, not one size or predictable traits.

sources.title: Gerdy’s Rescues and Adoptions — Inko parentage
sources.evidence: New primary rescue body returned in search index explicitly says it knows Inko’s mother was Beagle and father black Poodle and calls him Poogle. Direct open timed out once and was not retried. Parentage sentence only; individual health, suitability and temperament excluded.
